invariants.rationale: Ensures file is non-null for method calls like file.parent() and file.child(token) to be valid.
path is used to construct a StringTokenizer and cannot be null.
An empty path leads the tokenizer to have zero tokens, which may not be intended.
file.parent() is called immediately and thus intended to return a non-null handle.
It is likely the input file should exist for its parent or children to have meaning.
